## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run format`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run test:e2e` pass
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test (writes: the file is byte-identical apart from the intended edit)
- [ ] Version bumped in `package.json` and an entry added to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] `docs/FEATURES.md` (and the README screenshots) updated for any visible change
